metadata.source: RBI Master Direction on Export Credit / DGFT IES / ICC UCP 600 / IFSCA ITFS

INR.name: RBI Repo Linked / 1-Yr Marginal Cost of Funds Lending Rate (MCLR)

interest_equalisation_scheme.statutory_authority: Ministry of Commerce & Industry / Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) & Reserve Bank of India

msme_manufacturer.title: Manufacturer MSME (Udyam Registered)
msme_manufacturer.description: 3.00% per annum government interest subsidy directly credited on pre- and post-shipment rupee export credit.

merchant_exporter.title: Merchant Exporter (Identified 410 HS Lines)
merchant_exporter.eligible_hs_chapters: 410 Specific Tariff Lines (Textiles, Garments, Leather, Handlooms, Agriculture)
merchant_exporter.description: 2.00% per annum government interest subsidy on pre- and post-shipment credit for labor-intensive exports.

standard_corporate.title: Large Corporate / Non-MSME Exporter
standard_corporate.description: Standard commercial bank interest rates without statutory interest subvention.

statutory_conditions: Exporter must hold valid Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) for MSME tier.
Credit must be liquidated within statutory FEMA realization window (9 months).
Bank submits claim directly to RBI export credit refinance window.

lc_discounting_rules.framework: ICC Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP 600)

discrepancy_risk_factors.title: Late Presentation
discrepancy_risk_factors.desc: Documents presented after 21 calendar days from onboard bill of lading date (UCP 600 Art 14c).

discrepancy_risk_factors.title: Inconsistent Description
discrepancy_risk_factors.desc: Description in commercial invoice does not correspond strictly with description in LC (Art 14e / Art 18c).

discrepancy_risk_factors.title: Claused Bill of Lading
discrepancy_risk_factors.desc: Transport document contains express clause declaring defective condition of goods or packaging.

discrepancy_risk_factors.title: Insurance Cover Date
discrepancy_risk_factors.desc: Insurance cover date is subsequent to date of shipment or transport document.

export_factoring_rules.framework: IFSCA (GIFT City ITFS) & TReDS International Factoring
export_factoring_rules.settlement_timeline: Day-1 Advance within 24 hours of bill of lading confirmation; balance retention credited upon foreign buyer settlement.
